consumer: mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) asking 'does the player's crafting_inventory hold the required count of the scrap itype?' to mark the salvage contract objective complete
scope: items reachable via crafting_inventory (carried plus nearby reachable/adjacent-container items), not on-person only and not a raw map-tile listing
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) -- calls u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(item_id,item_count) with a has_charges fallback and returns the engine's completion verdict
divergence: Required scrap sits in the player's worn/carried inventory or a reachable adjacent container but not loose on a nearby map tile: crafting_inventory().has_amount returns complete, yet re-deriving from the tile-stack item export (write_entities) sees zero on the ground and wrongly reports 'not all there yet'; conversely loose scrap on a tile outside crafting reach would be wrongly counted present
